$comment: The Unicode Consortium's conformance test files for the kernel's segmentation (WASM-007). They are test data, downloaded once from unicode.org on 2026-11-18 on owner decision 224 of docs/owner-decisions-2026-11-15.md, and kept byte for byte as downloaded (the files are read, never run). The folder name is the Unicode version of the file's URL. Each version is the one that a pinned crate implements (crates/layout-kernel/Cargo.toml): unicode-linebreak 0.1.5 implements Unicode 15.0.0 and unicode-segmentation 1.13.3 implements Unicode 17.0.0, so the two files are of different versions. Upgrading a crate means downloading the file of its new version, changing the entry here (the test checks the SHA-256 and the version in the file's header), and rerunning the tests. Licence: the Unicode Terms of Use (https://www.unicode.org/terms_of_use.html), named in each file's header; the notice is kept in the files, and licences/kernel-data.json records the review.

files.algorithm: UAX #14, the default Line Breaking Algorithm
